name: Forensics
description: Investigate public sources, organize private cases and inspect evidence, relationships and timelines.
abilities: Private append-only cases and attributable evidence
Public records and passive infrastructure research
Relationship graphs, timelines and heuristic analysis
Versioned investigation workflows and downloadable reports
permissions: Case changes follow Workspace authorization and are private to the account
Public collection is bounded; no private networks, logins or active browser probes
Offline file analysis uses the existing read-only Code Sandbox

changes.notes: Native deferred Forensics tools using a pinned shared implementation; no MCP server setup. Standalone integrations and their data are unchanged.
